description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data across five distinct categories, each representing a different knowledge aggregation method or dataset. The largest segment, colored red, corresponds to TriviaQA, which accounts for 46% of the total, with a value of 1829. The second largest segment, in purple, represents WebQA, making up 25% (997). The green segment, labeled HalluEval, constitutes 18% (721) of the total. HalluQA, shown in light blue, represents 5% (185) of the data. The smallest segment, in yellow, is labeled with 6% (231), though its specific category name is not provided in the chart. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting from TriviaQA and moving clockwise through the other categories. Each segment is clearly labeled with its percentage and corresponding numerical value, and the chart includes a legend indicating the color associated with each category.
